complete.limitation: Separate request-normalized diagnostic windows, not E2E timing or an exclusive cause partition. ANY_ANT and MISP_ANT describe particular conditional-branch conditions, not all BTB misses. Do not divide MISP_ANT by ANY_ANT as a misprediction probability: the published ANY_ANT definition excludes mispredicted branches. CPU-pool and service scopes overlap. Critical DSB and ITLB events can overlap cache/branch costs. The cost75 candidate is fixed independently of performance outcomes.
